payload.text: At cc's About-reader commit (decision 10), check: one reader in src/fs.rs serves every About read, NotFound as None and any other error named and returned to the coordinator; read_text (lossy) at tree.rs's header and aliases reads, grep.rs, tags.rs's two reads and contact.rs:792; read_exact (strict, naming a non-UTF-8 file) at every write-back: sync --pull, rename.rs, tags render, pictures.rs; --pull names the real cause per person; the three tests run red then green; no golden changed. Then amend WP14's body to drop its fourth edge case, and vc's clean-clone run. It lands before WP13.
